items.alt: Three CJP protest leaders emerge from a street stall with the Indian flag as police stop them at yellow barricades near Jantar Mantar.
Playful circuit-like agents hop from a television to household appliances while a resident tries to unplug the system, illustrating a potential AI self-replication risk.
A shopkeeper hides a fee calendar behind Diwali sweets while a customer scans a UPI QR code at the counter.
A shopper with a nearly empty wallet looks up at rising produce while a vendor weighs vegetables and grain at a busy Indian market.
A disappointed dark-haired tennis player watches a blond opponent celebrate, while a third player stands beside a prominent number-one trophy.
A worried globe and exhausted officials huddle beneath a damaged umbrella atop a leaking oil barrel amid storm clouds and fuel supplies.
